title: 第9章 加快节奏的杀人剑第10章 再一次被抓的盲僧
content_zh:
第九章 加快节奏的杀人剑
感谢疯子skt和天地乾坤大挪移的打赏。
咳咳，不过作者君还是想说一句：我还要，我还要！
顺便求推荐，
下面是正文：
最终，苏环还是逃出生天了，死血极限逃生，顺便还秀了紫色方中单豹女一脸。
当苏环在河道一簇草丛中回城的时候，他看见紫色方盲僧刚从紫色方四鬼处朝着中路河道赶来。
不过这时候他的回城时间只剩一秒了，基本盲僧要白跑一趟了。
…………
当听到双杀的提示之后，紫色方下路伊泽瑞尔则有些不淡定了。
要知道他们下路二打一还没把对面女警干掉，虽然说这是对面女警太过猥琐的结果，只敢时不时的用‘和平使者’猥琐的补兵，使得伊泽瑞尔和琴女有点无从下手。
但是也是保持着压制，兵线也是微微的控制住。
可是却想不到时间不到4分钟出头对面瑞雯就已经三个人头在身了，这是要把瑞雯养成大魔王的节奏？
“你们怎么回事，现在才4分多钟，就送了三个人头给瑞雯了，这游戏还能玩！？”
“潘森，你怎么还是一级啊。对面瑞雯都四级了。”
这时候琴女发现潘森的等级，非常无语。
听到两人的疑问。
盲僧和潘森都没有说话。
盲僧却是因为那一记极近距离下天音波的未命中，而有些羞愧异常，难以开口反驳什么，而且还送了双BUFF给瑞雯。
使得他现在没有红BUFF的效果下，前期Gank会有些艰难。

且双BUFF在瑞雯身上，估计上路潘森更加艰难了。
至于潘森，心里非常后悔，他表示一句话都不想说了。
要是自己刚刚不去支援盲僧，让其自生自灭，而自己跑去线上补兵的话，现在他估计都三级了，哪还会相差瑞雯等级那么大。
豹女则是心中叹了口气，作为刚刚被秀了一脸操作的他，感觉非常不好。
心里则是有种不祥的预感，对面瑞雯明显不是这一分段的，不管是操作，还是走位，都极其的犀利。
尤其是当自己以为那标枪投掷可以收下其人头的时候，却没想到对方击杀潘森的时候，竟然升级逃过了一截。
最让自己震撼的，还是石像鬼的那一次预判闪现，实在是亮瞎了他的豹眼了。
要不是对方是敌人，他都要膜拜了。
难道这一把要输？
摇了摇头，豹女把这想法甩出，五打三，要是输的话，自己以后就不玩英雄联盟了，太伤心了。
“瞎子，你等下就在野区发育，我们打稳一点，后期完全是可以碾压他们的。”
“至于潘森……”
随后豹女看了看潘森，则是有点头疼，四分钟出头连两级都不到，这被压得也太惨了，还是一个能克制瑞雯的英雄。
“潘森，你注意别再送人头就行了。上塔能放弃就放弃吧。”
“嗯”潘森闷闷的应道，表示自己知道了。
回到泉水后，苏环看着自己身上将近两千的经济，不由得微微一笑。
如果是按照以往5V5的常规打法下，他首件装备选项会出一个残暴之力，既有百分之十的破甲效果，又有着百分之十的减CD效果，是非常适合像瑞雯这样一个以攻为守的冷却又长的英雄的。
不过，看着潘森那连两级都未到的状态，再看看自己已经四级出头，脚下又有双BUFF在身。
只要到线上潘森敢过来长矛投掷自己，他就敢一套带走对方。
现在己方是一个3V5的状态，所以不能拖节奏，得要加快节奏才行，不然后期的话，是没得打的。

所以苏环直接二话不说，第一件装备买起。
神秘之剑！！
俗称杀人剑。
只要杀人或助攻，就能叠起层次，增加攻击力。
一件非常不稳定拖节奏的装备。
“杀人剑，这样不会拖节奏吗？”后方王清雅心头一震，有些疑惑。
“不，或许这样更能加快游戏节奏。”随后她转念一想，分析上路双方的情况。
发现现在杀人剑在这一把瑞雯有着极大优势的情况下，是非常能加快节奏的。
瑞雯四级，身上红蓝双BUFF，而对面潘森不过才一级，只要看见瑞雯，一个走位失误的话，就可能被瑞雯一套带走。
在这一把中，瑞雯出杀人剑是非常能加快节奏的利器。
瑞雯双BUFF在身，潘森要是敢呼叫打野的话，很有可能直接抓不死瑞雯，反而有着极大可能再次送出双杀。
而凭着其刚刚瑞雯的操作，这完全是毫无疑问的。
一套分析下来，王清雅愈加佩服眼前的这位玩家。
“或许可以邀请对方加入学校的电竞社，虽然说电竞社已经有了楚天那位华贵铂金I的上单，但是高手，不管多少估计哥哥都是不嫌多的。”
打定主意，王清雅决定等这把游戏完了之后，就邀请苏环加入电竞社。
只不过他不知道的是，电竞社的楚天抢了苏环的女友，还和他定下了两天后的Solo局。
花了1200买了神秘之剑，随后苏环买了一双草鞋，和一把长剑，顺便买了一瓶血瓶和一个侦查守卫。
之后苏环便马不停蹄的往上路赶去，由于潘森刚刚又死了一次，有着复活时间，所以当瑞雯赶到上路的时候，潘森也同时到达。
一看到瑞雯，潘森脸色一白，随后有些屁滚尿流的直接跑回了防御塔内，退出经验区。随后才松了一口气，心里微微有些安全感。
看着潘森的样子，王清雅差点笑出声，不由得捂住了嘴巴。

苏环一看也是乐了，看来自己给潘森留下了很大的阴影啊。
看着前面一大波兵线，苏环一下普攻收下一个小兵人头。随后毫不犹豫的第一段‘折翼之舞’交出。
刷刷刷，三段‘折翼之舞’交出，瞬间把紫色方兵线清得寥寥无几。
这一次，苏环并不打算控线了，看着对方一级的潘森，打算来个塔下强杀。
推完这一大波兵线后，苏环升到了五级，‘折翼之舞’被升到了三级，其伤害普攻，已经达到非常恐怖的效果了。
潘森看着一大波兵线被推进来，不由得有些泪流满面，终于可以升到两级了。
然而就在小兵就要进入防御塔的仇恨中时，苏环一个勇往直前率先进入。
瞬间吸引了防御塔的仇恨，一发晃晃悠悠的能量直射而来。
苏环这一次向前并不是冲动，其主要目的只是为了拖延潘森到两级的时间。
如果潘森有点意识的话，应该会选择用长矛飞掷来扎死小兵升级，然后学习圣盾打击。
只不过看着自己飞快接近，潘森下意识的就是一发长矛投掷，扎在苏环身上。
只是打掉了勇往直前撑起的半截护盾而已。
伤害之低，就在等级的差距呈现出来了。
只不过刚刚扎出后，潘森便后悔了。他发誓，这只是他看见瑞雯突进过来，下意识的动作而已。
见对方并没有先升两级，苏环一愣，不过手下却不慢，第一段‘折翼之舞’甩出，迅速拉近与潘森的距离，随后一记普攻打出，配合着红BUFF的灼伤效果，瞬间打掉了潘森四分之一的血量。
伤害之高，令人发指。
而在这时第一发防御塔的能量击中了苏环，打掉了勇往直前半截护盾。
苏环毫不在意，接上第二段‘折翼之舞’打在潘森身上，几乎同一时间接上普攻。
又是打掉潘森一大截血量。
content_en:
Chapter 9 The murderous sword that speeds up the pace
Thanks to Madman skt and The Great Shift of Heaven and Earth for the reward.
Ahem, but the author still wants to say: I want it more, I want it more!
Please give me a recommendation,
The following is the text:
In the end, Su Huan escaped, bleeding to the limit of death, and showing off the look of a leopard girl in a purple square.
When Su Huan returned to the city in a tuft of grass in the river, he saw the purple square blind monk just coming towards the middle river from the purple square four ghosts.
But at this time, he only had one second left to return to the city, and the blind monk's journey was basically in vain.
…………
After hearing the prompt of the double kill, the purple bottom laner Ezreal was a little uneasy.
You must know that their two-on-one bottom lane has not killed the female policewoman on the opposite side. Although this is the result of the female policewoman on the opposite side being too wretched, they only dare to use the "Peacemaker" wretchedly to replenish their troops from time to time, making Ezreal and Qin Nu unable to start.
However, they maintained suppression and the military line was slightly controlled.
However, he didn't expect that in less than 4 minutes, there were already three heads on the opposite side of Riven. Is this to develop Riwen into the rhythm of a big devil?
"What's going on with you guys? It's only been more than 4 minutes and you've given three heads to Riven. Is this game still playable!?"
"Pan Sen, why are you still at Level 1? The opposite person, Ruiwen, is already at Level 4."
At this time, Qin Nu found out Pan Sen's level and was very speechless.
I heard the two people's questions.
Neither Blind Monk nor Pantheon spoke.
The blind monk, however, was a little ashamed because of the missed hit of the Sky Sound Wave at an extremely close range, and could not say anything to refute, and even gave Riwen a pair of BUFFs.
As a result, without the effect of the red BUFF, it will be a bit difficult to gank in the early stage.
And with the double BUFF on Riven, it will probably be even more difficult for Pan Sen on the road.
As for Pan Sen, he felt very regretful and said he didn’t want to say a word anymore.
If he had not supported the blind monk just now and left him to fend for himself, but went to the line to replenish troops, he would probably be at level three now, and there would be no such big difference from Riwen's level.
Leopard Girl sighed in her heart. As someone who had just been exposed to manipulation, he felt very bad.
There was an ominous premonition in my heart. The opposite person, Rui Wen, was obviously not in this category. She was extremely sharp in both operation and positioning.
Especially when I thought that the javelin throw could take away his head, I didn't expect that when the other party killed Pan Sen, he even escaped with an upgrade.
What shocked him the most was the flash of prediction from the gargoyle, which really blinded him.
If the other party wasn't an enemy, he would have worshiped him.
Are you going to lose this one?
Shaking her head, Leopard Girl shook off the idea. Five versus three. If she lost, she would never play League of Legends again. It would be too sad.
"Blind man, you can develop in the jungle later. Let's be more steady. We can completely crush them in the later stage."
"As for Pan Sen..."
Then Leopard Girl looked at Pan Sen and felt a little headache. He couldn't even reach two levels in four minutes. It was too miserable to be suppressed. He was still a hero who could restrain Riven.
"Pan Sen, just be careful not to give away more lives. If you can give up on going up to the tower, just give up."
"Yeah" Pan Sen responded dully, indicating that he understood.
After returning to the spring, Su Huan looked at his financial fortune of nearly two thousand and couldn't help but smile.
If he plays according to the conventional 5V5 playing style in the past, his first equipment option will have a brutal force, which has a 10% armor-breaking effect and a 10% CD reduction effect. It is very suitable for an offense-defensive hero like Riven with a long cooldown.
However, looking at Pan Sen's state of not even reaching level two, and then seeing that he is already in his early fourth level, with two BUFFs at his feet.
As long as Pan Sen dares to come over and throw a spear at himself on the line, he willJust dare to take the other party away.
Now we are in a 3V5 situation, so we can't slow down the tempo, we have to speed up the tempo, otherwise we won't be able to fight in the later stages.
So Su Huan bought the first piece of equipment without saying a word.
The mysterious sword! !
Commonly known as the killing sword.
As long as you kill someone or assist, you can stack up levels and increase your attack power.
A very unstable and slow-paced piece of equipment.
"Killing sword, won't this slow down the pace?" Wang Qingya from behind was shocked and a little confused.
"No, maybe this can speed up the pace of the game." Then she changed her mind and analyzed the situation of both sides on the road.
I found that the murderous sword can speed up the pace very much now that Riven has a huge advantage.
Riven is level 4, with both red and blue buffs on her body, while the opposite Pan Sen is only level 1. As long as he sees Riven, if he makes a mistake in his position, he may be taken away by her.
In this one, Riven's killing sword is a very powerful weapon that can speed up the tempo.
Riven has both BUFFs. If Pan Sen dares to call the jungler, he may not be able to catch Riven directly, but he is very likely to send out a double kill again.
And based on Ruiwen's operation just now, there is absolutely no doubt about this.
After a set of analysis, Wang Qingya admired the player in front of her even more.
"Perhaps we can invite him to join the school's e-sports club. Although the e-sports club already has Chu Tian's luxurious Platinum I top laner, no matter how many masters there are, I guess my brother will never be too many."
After making up her mind, Wang Qingya decided to invite Su Huan to join the e-sports club after the game was over.
But what he didn't know was that Chu Tian from the e-sports club stole Su Huan's girlfriend and made a solo match with him two days later.
After spending 1,200 on the mysterious sword, Su Huan bought a pair of straw sandals and a long sword. He also bought a blood bottle and a reconnaissance guard.
After that, Su Huan rushed to the upper road non-stop. Since Pan Sen had just died again and had time to resurrect, when Riwen rushed to the upper road, Pan Sen also arrived at the same time.
As soon as he saw Ruiwen, Pan Sen's face turned pale, and then he ran back to the defense tower in a fit of piss and exited the experience area. Then I breathed a sigh of relief, feeling slightly safe.
Seeing Pan Sen's appearance, Wang Qingya almost laughed out loud and couldn't help but cover her mouth.
Su Huan was also happy when he saw it. It seemed that he had left a big shadow on Pan Sen.
Looking at the large wave of soldiers in front of him, Su Huan took a small soldier's head with a basic attack. Then the first section of ‘Dance of Broken Wings’ was delivered without hesitation.
Swipe, swipe, swipe, three sections of the 'Dance of Broken Wings' were handed over, instantly clearing the line of purple square soldiers.
This time, Su Huan didn't plan to control the line. Looking at the opponent's Level 1 Pan Sen, he planned to kill him under the tower.
After pushing this large wave of soldiers, Su Huan was upgraded to level five, and the 'Dance of Broken Wings' was upgraded to level three. Its damaging basic attack has already achieved a very terrifying effect.
Pan Sen couldn't help but burst into tears when he saw a large wave of soldiers being pushed in. He could finally reach level two.
However, just when the soldiers were about to enter the hatred of the defense tower, Su Huan stepped forward bravely and entered first.
Instantly attracting the hatred of the defense tower, a wave of swaying energy shot straight towards him.
Su Huan's move forward this time was not impulsive. Its main purpose was just to delay Pan Sen's time to reach level two.
If Panson had any sense, he would have chosen to use a spear to kill the minions to upgrade, and then learn Holy Shield Strike.
But seeing himself approaching quickly, Pan Sen subconsciously threw a spear and pierced Su Huan.
It only knocked down half of the shield that Courage had put up.
The low damage is reflected in the level difference.
But just after it was inserted, Pan Sen regretted it. He swore that this was just a subconscious action when he saw Ruiwen rushing towards him.Seeing that the opponent had not upgraded two levels first, Su Huan was stunned, but his subordinates were not slow. He threw out the first "Dance of Broken Wings" and quickly closed the distance with Pan Sen. Then he launched a basic attack, which, combined with the burning effect of the red BUFF, instantly knocked out a quarter of Pan Sen's health.
The damage was so high that it was appalling.
At this moment, the energy of the first defensive tower hit Su Huan, knocking off half of the shield of Courageous Forward.
Su Huan didn't care, and hit Pan Sen with the second "Dance of Broken Wings", and followed up with a basic attack almost at the same time.
Another huge chunk of Pan Sen's health was knocked out.
